name: Pane
where_agents_run: your machine + a self-hosted remote host (VM, server, WSL, Mac mini) over Tailscale or SSH; phone or browser through its web app
source_note: Checked against its README, docs/ folder, source code, latest release (v2.4.138) and runpane.com. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Any terminal agent side by side

harness_count.value: Any CLI agent; 3 with built-in status reading

needs_you_signal.value: Status dots per pane read from the screen; phone push

approve_deny_prompt.value: Allow/deny dialog for Claude Code only, when enabled

cross_provider_delegation.value: Pane Chat hands work to agent panes, listed together

always_on_assistant.value: Pane Chat: standing orchestrator chat, reachable by phone

real_terminal.value: Real terminal per agent, 50,000 lines of scrollback

session_organization.value: Projects, then panes (one worktree each), then tabs

saved_prompt_library.value: Text snippets on a shortcut; no attached context

builtin_editors_browser.value: Browser tab, code editor, file explorer, diff viewer

appearance_control.value: Light and dark palettes plus terminal font and size

usage_hud.value: Tokens and cost per pane; plan limits for Codex only

burn_rate_forecast.value: Current use and reset only; no forecast

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Watches pull requests; issue trackers left to agents

worktree_management.value: Worktree per pane, cleanup, merge from the keyboard

planner_orchestrator.value: Pane Chat splits a goal into tickets and starts agents

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents start and message other panes via its MCP server

native_mobile_app.value: iOS and Android test builds; not in the stores yet

phone_no_new_app.value: Browser web app; needs Tailscale or an SSH tunnel

remote_ssh.value: Agents, files and git on another machine

voice_input.value: Dictation in phone and browser; not desktop

os.value: Windows, macOS, Linux; phone through the browser

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Medium (estimate: Electron app plus terminal host)

runs_in_terminal.value: No; own desktop app with its own terminals

extensibility.value: Scriptable command-line tool and MCP server; no plugins
